metaDesc: Free Spotify song requests for Twitch. Viewers type !sr in chat and the track lands in your real Spotify queue. Needs Spotify Premium, set up in about two minutes.
title: Your chat picks the soundtrack.
lead: Viewers type !sr in chat and the track lands in your real Spotify queue. Free on every ItsBagelBot plan.
howTitle: Three steps, then it runs itself.
step1Desc: Bring your own Spotify application: create it once in Spotify's developer dashboard, paste the credentials on the Song Requests page, and they are sealed on our side, never exposed.
step2Desc: Viewers type !sr with a song name or a Spotify link. The bot resolves the track and adds it to the queue.
step3Desc: Requests drive your actual Spotify player, so queue positions stay in sync with what is really playing. No separate in-browser playlist.
cmd1Desc: Request a song by name or Spotify link.
cmd3Desc: Skip the track that is playing.
cmd4Desc: Say what is playing right now.
limitsNote: Per-viewer limits, queue caps and moderator skip controls all live in the dashboard.
faqQ1: How do viewers request a song on Twitch?
faqA1: They type !sr followed by a song name or a Spotify link in chat. ItsBagelBot resolves the track and adds it to the streamer's Spotify queue.
faqA2: Yes. Requests drive the streamer's actual Spotify player, so queue positions stay in sync with what is really playing. It is not a separate in-browser playlist.
faqA3: Yes. Song requests are part of the free tier, forever.
faqA4: Yes. Per-viewer limits, queue caps and moderator skip controls, all configured in the dashboard.
faqQ5: What do I need on the Spotify side?
faqA5: A Spotify Premium account, because Spotify only lets apps control the queue on Premium. You also need your own Spotify app from the developer dashboard, and Spotify playing on a device while requests come in.
faqQ6: I already use another bot. Do I have to start over?
faqA6: No. The import wizard brings your commands over from Nightbot, StreamElements, Moobot, Streamlabs Chatbot, Fossabot or WizeBot, and you review every item before it is written.
faqA7: The bot says why in chat, and a channel-point request gets its points back. The usual causes: Spotify isn't playing on any device, the account isn't Premium, or the Spotify connection needs reconnecting on the dashboard.
faqQ8: Do requests work while I'm offline?
faqA8: Only while you are live by default. Turn off Live only on the Song Requests page and !sr works between streams too.
